title: Trinity Sandbox Profile
description: Capability declaration for a sandboxed Trinity session actor. Authoritative shape; see docs/specs/TRINITY_SANDBOX_CAPABILITY_SPEC_V1.md for prose. Rank-5 workflow contract per Constitution Article XXV. RecordProxy-aligned: §2.1 fs.delete_roots, §2.3 proc.spawn_allowed, §2.5 authority.ddd_propose_allowed, §2.6 audit.read_allowed + policy.read_allowed axes added (all optional for backward compatibility with existing v1 profiles).

id.description: Profile identifier; lowercase letters, digits, underscore, dash; 1..64 chars.

read_roots.description: Repo-relative directory roots the actor MAY read. Empty array = no FS read.

write_roots.description: Repo-relative directory roots the actor MAY write. Empty array = read-only.

delete_roots.description: Repo-relative directory roots the actor MAY delete files in. Empty array = no FS delete (default). Enforced as strict subset of write_roots. Maps to Tool capability fs.delete (TRINITY_TOOL_CAPABILITY_MODEL_V1 §2.1). Added in RecordProxy alignment v2.

forbidden_paths.description: Glob patterns the actor MUST NOT touch, even if otherwise covered by read/write/delete roots. Forbidden trumps allowed.

max_bytes_per_file.description: Reject writes larger than this; 0 = no per-file limit.

max_total_bytes.description: Reject the session if cumulative writes exceed; 0 = no total limit.

outbound.description: 'denied' is the default for COLD-tier rituals.

allowlist.description: Required iff outbound == 'allowlist'. Hostname patterns; no wildcards inside a single label.

allowed_binaries.description: Whitelist of binaries the actor MAY exec. Empty array = no exec.

spawn_allowed.description: If false, actor MUST NOT spawn detached/background subprocesses (only synchronous exec). Maps to Tool capability proc.spawn (TRINITY_TOOL_CAPABILITY_MODEL_V1 §2.1). Added in RecordProxy alignment v2.

max_wallclock_seconds.description: Reject any single command beyond this limit; 0 = no limit.

allowed.description: Tool contract IDs the actor MAY invoke. Empty array = no tool invocation.

forbidden.description: Tool contract IDs hard-denied even if otherwise allowed.

may_promote.description: If false, actor MUST NOT issue a ddd-promote (Article XIII).

may_deploy.description: If false, actor MUST NOT trigger deploy (Article XIII).

may_modify_policies.description: If false, actor MUST NOT write to .ai/policies/**. Per Article III this is false for all AI actors.

ddd_propose_allowed.description: If false, actor MUST NOT emit a ddd.packet_emitted event. Maps to Tool capability ddd.propose (TRINITY_TOOL_CAPABILITY_MODEL_V1 §2.1). Note: ddd.decide is human-only per Article XIII and not representable as a sandbox grant. Added in RecordProxy alignment v2.

audit.description: Optional audit-access axis. Added in RecordProxy alignment v2 (TRINITY_SANDBOX_CAPABILITY_SPEC_V1 §2.6).

read_allowed.description: If true, actor MAY read .ai/audit/events.ndjson and per-session <session>/CAPTURE/capture.sqlite audit_events table. Maps to Tool capability audit.read. Writes are kernel-only (audit.append is never tool-granted).

policy.description: Optional policy-access axis. Added in RecordProxy alignment v2 (TRINITY_SANDBOX_CAPABILITY_SPEC_V1 §2.6).

read_allowed.description: If true, actor MAY read .ai/policies/**. Maps to Tool capability policy.read. Writes to .ai/policies/** are governed by authority.may_modify_policies (Article III).
